original_test_intent: Collect and validate the selected BMC Manager LogService Entries collection as bounded, read-only evidence while preserving existing entries and protecting sensitive log content.
original_method: Resolve the intended Manager and LogService from advertised Redfish links, then use trusted curl/jq to retrieve a bounded page/time window, validate collection and entry structure, and export only approved redacted evidence without clearing or deleting logs.
manual_activity: The BMC/log owner authorizes the exact Manager and LogService, defines the allowed time/page/record scope and expected entry fields, supplies least-privilege access, and approves retention and redaction of potentially sensitive content.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Approved page, record and time bounds
Expected timestamp, severity, message and ordering policy
Sensitive-log redaction, retention and secure-export policy
safety_requirements: Preserve existing logs despite the conflicting Master clear-logs instruction
Never clear, delete or acknowledge entries
Do not combine guessed Manager and LogService IDs
Do not export unrestricted raw logs or credentials
No account, configuration, firmware, power or chassis mutation
agent_execution_scope: Collect only approved pages, records and time range
Detect repeated/cyclic next links and enforce hard bounds
Capture status/headers and access-controlled raw hashes
Validate collection count, Members, entry schema, timestamps, severity and ordering
Export redacted evidence and no-mutation audit
engineer_actions: Authorize target LogService and collection scope
Approve privacy, retention and redaction policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The URI shape matches the source and variable guards prevent empty IDs, but ipmitool is the wrong package, variable presence does not prove link identity, `-k`/basic-auth handling is unsafe and the command is unbounded and privacy-blind.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using trusted curl/jq and secret-safe least-privilege authentication, follow advertised Manager and LogService links, GET Entries under explicit page/record/time bounds, stop on repeated next links or schema errors, validate approved fields, and export redacted evidence without clearing, deleting or acknowledging entries.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manager LogService Entries read and 15/10 timing remain; no ManagerId, LogServiceId, pagination bound, time range or acceptable entries are inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the LogService collection as sensitive evidence: preserve its baseline, resolve identity from Redfish links, enforce deterministic collection bounds, validate entry semantics and retain only approved redacted output.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes destructive log clearing, hardcoded credentials and TLS bypass; adds authoritative identity, bounded pagination, schema/order validation and privacy controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The corrected review preserves existing and newly generated entries instead of erasing the pre-test baseline. It validates collection mechanics and content structure, not the correctness of every underlying platform event.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Logs may contain credentials, hostnames, user names, topology and fault details; server-side filters may be unsupported or unstable, so client-side hard bounds and restricted raw capture are mandatory.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent only if it preserves advertised link identity, certificate binding, HTTP/pagination evidence, deterministic bounds and redaction. A later similarly named testcase or ipmitool SEL output cannot replace this Manager LogService Entries contract.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC, Manager and LogService identity plus certificate/trust result
Validated link chain and firmware/schema versions
Approved page/record/time bounds and privacy policy
Redacted HTTP status/headers, collection count and page audit
Validated Members, timestamps, severity/message fields and ordering
Access-controlled raw response hashes and redacted export

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master tells the operator to clear logs immediately before collecting LogService Entries. That destroys the pre-existing evidence the named test is supposed to collect and conflicts with its collection purpose. The Review layer preserves the source text, records the conflict and prohibits clearing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only collection intent and Redfish resource family are explicit. Exact link identity, bounds, schema, trust, credentials and privacy approval are concrete prerequisites rather than an unresolved operation definition.

review_improvement: Records the clear-versus-collect contradiction and converts an unsafe unbounded curl into an identity-bound, privacy-controlled, terminating Redfish evidence collection.
independent_technical_reasoning: A LogService collection can be large, paginated and mutable while it is read. Clearing it first eliminates prior fault evidence and biases the result toward an empty or incomplete baseline. Manager and service IDs must therefore come from the selected BMC's links, and the collector must cap pages, records and time while detecting repeated next links. Entry count alone is not sufficient: each retained member needs schema, timestamp, severity/message and ordering checks, with raw access restricted and exported content redacted.
